notes.title: Escape First Update Patch
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We just released a new update for the game, addressing some of the issues you have brought to our attention in the last week.

Here is a brief list of some of our changes:
[list]
[*] Changed "Theory of Relativity" riddle and hint.
[*] Fixed colliders in Red Button's last room
[*] Improved the in-game hint for Red Button's drink riddle
[*] Fixed a bug with Versus mode and the "Give Hint" button.
[*] Fixed colliders in Lost In Time.
[/list]

Thank you for playing,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: Escape First is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32627052/5c11dac92ff87eaf7e60e2742b1237bcb0890502.png[/img]

[h1]Hello and welcome to Escape First![/h1]

[b][u]Escape First[/u][/b] is a multiplayer escape room adventure game that features three unique experiences to play through! Gather up to six people and work together to solve puzzles and escape before time is up!

[i]But wait, there is more[/i],  you can choose to play as a Team, using cooperation to win the game, or you can enable [b]Challenge Mode[/b] hand race your friends to the exit!

[i]Who will Escape First?[/i]

Thank you and have a great time escaping!
